tool_signatures.name: add
tool_signatures.description: Execute add

tool_signatures.name: add_output_parameter
tool_signatures.description: Add an output parameter to a build configuration; used to pass values between builds in a chain. Returns the created parameter; returns 404 if the configuration is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: add_parameter
tool_signatures.description: Add a parameter to a build configuration. Returns the created parameter; returns 404 if the configuration is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: add_project_parameter
tool_signatures.description: Add a parameter to a project. Returns the created parameter; returns 404 if the project does not exist.

tool_signatures.name: add_vcs_root_to_build
tool_signatures.description: Attach a VCS root to a build configuration. Returns the attached VCS root entry; returns 404 if the configuration or VCS root is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: analyze_build_problems
tool_signatures.description: Analyze and report build problems and failures.

tool_signatures.name: assign_agent_to_pool
tool_signatures.description: Assign an agent to a different pool. Returns the agent

tool_signatures.name: authorize_agent
tool_signatures.description: Authorize or unauthorize a build agent. Returns the new authorization state; returns 404 if the agent is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: bulk_set_agents_enabled
tool_signatures.description: Bulk enable or disable agents selected by pool or locator, with optional comment and schedule. Returns counts of agents updated and skipped; returns 404 if the pool is unknown or 400 if the locator is malformed.

tool_signatures.name: cancel_build
tool_signatures.description: Cancel or stop a running or queued build, with optional comment and requeue flag. Returns the cancelled build; returns 404 if the build is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: cancel_queued_build
tool_signatures.description: Cancel a queued (not-yet-running) build. Idempotent; returns 404 if the build already started or was cancelled.

tool_signatures.name: cancel_queued_builds_by_locator
tool_signatures.description: Cancel all queued builds matching a queue locator expression. Returns the count of cancelled builds; returns 400 if the locator is malformed.

tool_signatures.name: cancel_queued_builds_for_build_type
tool_signatures.description: Cancel all queued builds for a specific build configuration. Returns the count of cancelled builds; returns 404 if the configuration is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: check_availability_guard
tool_signatures.description: Evaluate server health. Returns ok=false when any ERROR-severity items are present.

tool_signatures.name: check_teamcity_connection
tool_signatures.description: Check connectivity and basic readiness of the TeamCity server.

tool_signatures.name: clone_build_config
tool_signatures.description: Clone an existing build configuration. Returns the new configuration (id and name); returns 404 if the source configuration is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: count_compatible_agents_for_build_type
tool_signatures.description: Count enabled agents compatible with a build type.

tool_signatures.name: create_build_config
tool_signatures.description: Create a new build configuration. Returns the created configuration (id and name); returns 409 if a configuration with the same id already exists.

tool_signatures.name: create_project
tool_signatures.description: Create a new TeamCity project. Returns the created project (id and name); returns 409 if a project with the same id already exists.

tool_signatures.name: create_vcs_root
tool_signatures.description: Create a new VCS root. Returns the created VCS root id; returns 409 if a VCS root with the same id already exists.

tool_signatures.name: delete
tool_signatures.description: Execute delete

tool_signatures.name: delete_output_parameter
tool_signatures.description: Delete an output parameter from a build configuration. Idempotent; returns 404 if the configuration is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: delete_parameter
tool_signatures.description: Delete a parameter from a build configuration. Idempotent; returns 404 if the configuration is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: delete_project
tool_signatures.description: Delete a TeamCity project. Irreversible; returns 404 if the project does not exist.

tool_signatures.name: delete_project_parameter
tool_signatures.description: Delete a parameter from a project. Idempotent; returns 404 if the project does not exist.

tool_signatures.name: delete_project_ssh_key
tool_signatures.description: Delete an SSH key from a project. Idempotent; returns 404 if the project or key is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: delete_vcs_root_property
tool_signatures.description: Delete a single VCS root property. Idempotent; returns 404 if the VCS root is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: download_build_artifact
tool_signatures.description: Download a single build artifact, with base64, text, or streaming output. Returns the artifact bytes or stream metadata; returns 404 if the build or path is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: download_build_artifacts
tool_signatures.description: Download multiple build artifacts, with base64, text, or streaming output. Returns per-artifact payloads or stream metadata; returns 404 if the build or any path is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: fetch_build_log
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a build log. Supports line-based pagination and streaming output.

tool_signatures.name: get_agent_enabled_info
tool_signatures.description: Get an agent

tool_signatures.name: get_build
tool_signatures.description: Get details of a specific build. Works for queued, running, and finished builds.

tool_signatures.name: get_build_config
tool_signatures.description: Get details of a build configuration.

tool_signatures.name: get_build_results
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed results of a build. Optionally includes tests, artifacts, changes, statistics, and dependencies.

tool_signatures.name: get_build_status
tool_signatures.description: Get build status. Optionally includes test and problem summaries plus queue context.

tool_signatures.name: get_compatible_agents_for_build_type
tool_signatures.description: List agents compatible with a build type. Optionally filters to enabled agents only.

tool_signatures.name: get_compatible_agents_for_queued_build
tool_signatures.description: List agents compatible with a queued or running build. Optionally filters to enabled agents only.

tool_signatures.name: get_compatible_build_types_for_agent
tool_signatures.description: List build types compatible with the specified agent.

tool_signatures.name: get_incompatible_build_types_for_agent
tool_signatures.description: List build types incompatible with the specified agent.

tool_signatures.name: get_mcp_mode
tool_signatures.description: Get the current MCP mode. Dev mode is read-only; full mode enables all operations.

tool_signatures.name: get_project
tool_signatures.description: Get details of a specific project.

tool_signatures.name: get_server_health_item
tool_signatures.description: Get a single server health item by locator.

tool_signatures.name: get_server_info
tool_signatures.description: Get TeamCity server info including version, build number, and state.

tool_signatures.name: get_server_metrics
tool_signatures.description: Fetch TeamCity server metrics (CPU, memory, disk, load) when available.

tool_signatures.name: get_test_details
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed information about test failures.

tool_signatures.name: get_vcs_root
tool_signatures.description: Get details of a VCS root, including its properties.

tool_signatures.name: get_versioned_settings_status
tool_signatures.description: Get Versioned Settings status for a project locator.

tool_signatures.name: list_agent_pools
tool_signatures.description: List agent pools. Supports pagination.

tool_signatures.name: list_agents
tool_signatures.description: List build agents. Supports pagination.

tool_signatures.name: list_branches
tool_signatures.description: List branches for a project or build configuration.

tool_signatures.name: list_build_artifacts
tool_signatures.description: List artifact files and directories for a build, optionally browsing into subdirectories. Returns an array of artifact entries with name, path, size, and isDirectory flag.

tool_signatures.name: list_build_configs
tool_signatures.description: List build configurations. Supports pagination and locator filtering.

tool_signatures.name: list_builds
tool_signatures.description: List TeamCity builds. Supports pagination and locator filtering.

tool_signatures.name: list_changes
tool_signatures.description: List VCS changes. Supports pagination.

tool_signatures.name: list_investigations
tool_signatures.description: List open investigations. Supports pagination.

tool_signatures.name: list_muted_tests
tool_signatures.description: List muted tests. Supports pagination.

tool_signatures.name: list_output_parameters
tool_signatures.description: List output parameters for a build configuration.

tool_signatures.name: list_parameters
tool_signatures.description: List parameters for a build configuration.

tool_signatures.name: list_problem_occurrences
tool_signatures.description: List build problem occurrences. Supports pagination.

tool_signatures.name: list_problems
tool_signatures.description: List build problems. Supports pagination.

tool_signatures.name: list_project_hierarchy
tool_signatures.description: List project hierarchy showing parent-child relationships.

tool_signatures.name: list_project_parameters
tool_signatures.description: List parameters for a project.

tool_signatures.name: list_project_ssh_keys
tool_signatures.description: List SSH keys configured for a project.

tool_signatures.name: list_projects
tool_signatures.description: List TeamCity projects. Supports pagination and locator filtering.

tool_signatures.name: list_queued_builds
tool_signatures.description: List queued builds. Supports TeamCity queue locator filtering and pagination.

tool_signatures.name: list_roles
tool_signatures.description: List defined roles and their permissions.

tool_signatures.name: list_server_health_items
tool_signatures.description: List server health items (warnings and errors). Useful for readiness checks.

tool_signatures.name: list_test_failures
tool_signatures.description: List test failures for a build. Supports pagination.

tool_signatures.name: list_users
tool_signatures.description: List TeamCity users. Supports pagination.

tool_signatures.name: list_vcs_roots
tool_signatures.description: List VCS roots. Supports pagination.

tool_signatures.name: manage_agent_requirements
tool_signatures.description: Add, update, or delete agent requirements for a build configuration. Returns the affected requirement or a delete confirmation; returns 404 if the configuration or requirement id is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: manage_build_dependencies
tool_signatures.description: Add, update, or delete artifact and snapshot dependencies for a build configuration. Returns the affected dependency or a delete confirmation; returns 404 if the configuration or dependency id is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: manage_build_features
tool_signatures.description: Add, update, or delete build features such as ssh-agent or requirements enforcement. Returns the affected feature or a delete confirmation; returns 404 if the configuration or feature id is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: manage_build_steps
tool_signatures.description: Add, update, or delete build steps. Returns the affected step or a delete confirmation; returns 404 if the configuration or step id is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: manage_build_triggers
tool_signatures.description: Add, update, or delete build triggers. Returns the affected trigger or a delete confirmation; returns 404 if the configuration or trigger id is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: move_queued_build_to_top
tool_signatures.description: Move a queued build to the top of the queue. Idempotent; returns 404 if the build is no longer queued.

tool_signatures.name: mute_tests
tool_signatures.description: Mute tests within a project or build configuration scope. Returns the created mute id; returns 404 if the scope id is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: pause_queue_for_pool
tool_signatures.description: Pause queue processing by disabling all agents in a pool, optionally cancelling queued builds for a build type. Returns counts of agents disabled and builds cancelled; returns 404 if the pool is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: ping
tool_signatures.description: Test MCP server connectivity. Returns a confirmation echo and optional message.

tool_signatures.name: remove_agent
tool_signatures.description: Remove a build agent from the TeamCity server, useful for cleaning up disconnected or ghost agent entries. Idempotent; returns 404 if the agent is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: reorder_queued_builds
tool_signatures.description: Reorder queued builds by providing the desired sequence of IDs. Returns the new queue order; returns 404 if any build id is no longer queued.

tool_signatures.name: resume_queue_for_pool
tool_signatures.description: Resume queue processing by re-enabling all agents in a pool. Returns the count of agents re-enabled; returns 404 if the pool is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: set_agent_enabled
tool_signatures.description: Enable or disable an agent, with optional comment and schedule. Returns the new enabled state; returns 404 if the agent is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: set_build_config_state
tool_signatures.description: Enable or disable a build configuration by toggling its paused flag. Returns the new paused state; returns 404 if the configuration is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: set_build_configs_paused
tool_signatures.description: Pause or unpause a list of build configurations, optionally cancelling their queued builds. Returns the count of configurations updated; returns 404 if any configuration is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: set_mcp_mode
tool_signatures.description: Switch MCP mode at runtime. Returns previous and current modes with the updated tool count; idempotent and notifies clients of the list change.

tool_signatures.name: set_vcs_root_property
tool_signatures.description: Set a single VCS root property such as branch, branchSpec, or url. Returns the updated value; returns 404 if the VCS root or property is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: trigger_build
tool_signatures.description: Trigger a new build; runs asynchronously, use

tool_signatures.name: update
tool_signatures.description: Execute update

tool_signatures.name: update_build_config
tool_signatures.description: Update build configuration settings. Returns the updated configuration; returns 404 if the configuration is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: update_output_parameter
tool_signatures.description: Update an output parameter in a build configuration. Returns the updated parameter; returns 404 if the configuration or parameter name is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: update_parameter
tool_signatures.description: Update a build configuration parameter. Returns the updated parameter; returns 404 if the configuration or parameter name is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: update_project_parameter
tool_signatures.description: Update a project parameter. Returns the updated parameter; returns 404 if the project or parameter name is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: update_project_settings
tool_signatures.description: Update project settings and parameters. Returns the updated project; returns 404 if the project does not exist.

tool_signatures.name: update_vcs_root_properties
tool_signatures.description: Update common VCS root properties in a single call. Returns the updated VCS root; returns 404 if the VCS root is unknown.

tool_signatures.name: upload_project_ssh_key
tool_signatures.description: Upload an SSH key to a project; provide either privateKeyContent or privateKeyPath, not both. Returns the uploaded key

tool_signatures.name: wait_for_build
tool_signatures.description: Wait for a build to reach a terminal state (finished, canceled, failed). Long-running; polls until completion or timeout.
